author: Zephyr I
title: Late dual-head time injection — Dilation=6 (std-width nodil, BASE_SEED=42)
abstract: Upper-bound dilation ablation: set CNN main-conv dilation to 6 (vs 5 baseline), with undilated bottlenecks, late dual-head time injection, and double-step LN-ConvLSTM(64). BASE_SEED=42.
